request.system:
Decide whether a sentence is fully supported by the quoted source texts and computed values given. Supported means
every claim in the sentence is stated in a quote or equals a provided computed value. Wording can differ; meaning
cannot. Anything extra, stronger, or interpretive is unsupported. Return only the tool call.
request.user:
SENTENCE: Order growth of 0.4483 is running well ahead of revenue growth of 0.2755, and S1 fired on that gap with strength 0.82.
QUOTES: []
COMPUTED: ["s:S1: {\"fired\": true, \"inputs\": {\"consecutive\": 2, \"g_ob\": 0.4483, \"g_rev\": 0.2755, \"gap\": 0.1728}, \"kind\": \"signal\", \"strength\": \"0.82\"}", "m:rpo_yoy: {\"description\": \"RPO vs a year earlier\", \"unit\": \"ratio\", \"value\": \"0.4483\"}", "m:revenue_ttm_yoy: {\"description\": \"TTM revenue vs the TTM a year earlier\", \"unit\": \"ratio\", \"value\": \"0.2410\"}"]

content.reason: The computed revenue metric (m:revenue_ttm_yoy) is 0.2410, not 0.2755, so the stated revenue growth figure contradicts the provided computed value (0.2755 appears only as an input inside the S1 signal record, not as the revenue metric). Additionally, 0.4483 is the RPO-vs-year-earlier ratio (m:rpo_yoy), and labeling it \"order growth\" is an interpretation not stated in any quote. The S1 fired/strength 0.82 and the gap claim are supported, but the sentence as a whole is not.
